articles.title: Toddlers found alone in Milwaukee: Parents located
articles.summary: Milwaukee police successfully located the parents of two young toddlers, a boy and a girl, who were found alone on Friday morning. Officers from the Milwaukee Police Department responded to the scene at approximately 9:20 a.m. The swift action of the police ensured the children's safety and their eventual reunification with guardians, underscoring the vital role of local law enforcement.

articles.title: Police Arrest Two Anchor-Dragging Ship's Crew Over Alleged Damage to Submarine Cables in Gulf of Finland
articles.summary: Finnish authorities have arrested two cargo ship crew members regarding damage to an undersea telecommunications cable in the Gulf of Finland. The investigation focuses on the vessel's involvement in an incident that impacted vital communication infrastructure. This development highlights ongoing international efforts to safeguard critical undersea networks and investigate potential disruptions.

articles.title: Army bolsters long-term warfighting capability with 90 pc ammunition indigenisation
articles.summary: The Indian Army, managing over 200 ammunition variants, is targeting more than 90% indigenization through focused policy reforms and increased industry engagement. This strategic move aims to bolster domestic manufacturing capabilities, enhance self-reliance in critical defence supplies, and modernize the arsenal for various weapon systems. Such initiatives are crucial for ensuring the Army's operational readiness and strategic autonomy.

articles.title: PM Modi reviews progress on acquisition of critical mineral assets abroad, sops for domestic recycling
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi reviewed India's strategic progress in acquiring critical mineral assets globally and assessed a Rs 1,500-crore incentive scheme. This initiative is crucial for securing vital resources essential for India's industrial growth and strategic independence. It underscores the nation's proactive approach towards future resource security and economic resilience, vital for national development and self-reliance.

articles.title: Germany takes first step towards reviving military service for 18-year-olds
articles.summary: Germany's defence ministry has begun reactivating military service, initiating the process by sending letters to all 18-year-olds. Defence Minister Boris Pistorius confirmed this move, signaling a potential return to conscription. This development underscores Germany's efforts to strengthen its armed forces and security posture, reflecting a significant policy shift amidst evolving geopolitical challenges. Aspiring officers should note the global trend towards bolstering national defence.
